title: Settings page
description: Vertical section tabs, profile form, settings rows with one control each, grouped sub-settings, danger zone

quality.sectionNav: Tabs orientation="vertical" with s={{ direction: "column" }} (and the TabList s={{ direction: "row" }}), one TabPanel per section, keepMounted on a form panel. Sections that are routes use NavItem href instead
quality.settingRow: One Setting per control — label and description left, control right. A list of Settings needs no surface around it
quality.grouping: Setting with a header control and open={enabled}, so sub-settings sit inside its box; Setting axes={…} for X/Y pairs
quality.explainers: info on a Setting (a Tooltip with content and no children: an info icon) instead of a description line that is only needed once
quality.forms: Profile fields in a Form (columns per breakpoint), not hand-spaced Columns
